shared_elements: low-relief curvilinear motifs on a broad flat panel
concentric circular motif (spiral in A, ringed disc in B)
curved arcing bands sweeping across the field
framing/edge lines bounding the decorated area
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow curvilinear carving centred on a rounded concentric motif (a double spiral in A, a ringed disc in B) with sweeping arcs and marginal framing lines, but that is about as generic as carved decoration gets. A depicts a recognisable elongated animal in profile above interlocked spirals, while B's motifs sit on the back of an anthropomorphic figure and comprise paired ring-and-crescent forms and a broad belt-like band; no specific motif or relationship is shared.
